result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd narrow it down to **1Password and Bitwarden**\. Both are excellent, but they suit slightly different priorities.

My overall recommendation is **1Password for ease of use and team collaboration**, or **Bitwarden for value and affordability**\.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

Approximately C\$29.95/month for up to 10 people on Teams Starter Pack, billed annually.

- Excellent user experience
- Shared vaults with granular permissions
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding
- Strong security and admin controls

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

US\$4/user/month for Teams, billed annually.

- Open-source software
- Secure shared collections
- Admin and audit tools
- Good cross-platform support
- Self-hosting options

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Business Starter advertised around US\$2/user/month.

- Good administrative controls
- Shared team folders
- Strong security and compliance features
- Useful for growing businesses

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

From approximately US\$1.99/user/month for Essentials, billed annually.

- Privacy-focused
- End-to-end encrypted vaults
- Secure sharing
- Email aliases and other privacy features

[Proton Pass business plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Pricing is approximate, based on published 2026 pricing, before applicable taxes. Confirm current Canadian pricing and plan limits before purchasing. ## Quick comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Open source | No | Yes |
| Self-hosting | No | Yes |
| Budget friendly | Good | Excellent |
| Growing teams | Excellent | Excellent |


## What I'd choose

- **2–10 employees\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack.
- **10–30 employees\:** Bitwarden Teams or 1Password Business.
- **Technical team\:** Bitwarden.
- **Non-technical team\:** 1Password.

Regardless of which you choose, enable MFA, require unique passwords, use shared team vaults rather than shared personal accounts, and establish an employee offboarding process.
